title: Frequency-relation ontology
provenance_caveat: Relation predicates are analytical definitions, not confirmed physical coupling.

records.mathematical_predicate: For lower-frequency base a and higher target t: f_t approximately n f_a.
records.duplicate_policy: Every accepted (base,target,n) is retained; no cross-order collapse.

records.mathematical_predicate: For reference r and lower target s: f_s approximately f_r/n.
records.duplicate_policy: Every accepted (reference,subharmonic,n) is retained; inverse harmonic ID is linked when present.
records.notes: Scientific status applied once; no physical mode claim.

records.mathematical_predicate: For frequency-ordered low a and high t: f_t approximately (p/q) f_a.
records.duplicate_policy: At most one ratio per unordered peak pair: minimize (normalized residual, p+q, p, q, predicted frequency).
records.notes: Reduced ratios only; q=1/integer harmonics are excluded from this family.

records.mathematical_predicate: For distinct sources a,b and distinct target t: f_t approximately f_a+f_b.
records.parameter_limits: Prediction must lie within min/max retained-peak frequency; source pair traversed once by retained rank.
records.tolerance_rule: Target lookup is inclusive on [prediction-delta_f_R, prediction+delta_f_R]; normalized residual <=1.
records.directionality: each source -> target in graph projection
records.duplicate_policy: Each matching target is retained; source peaks are excluded as targets; no additional collapse.
records.notes: The two source IDs follow retained-rank pair order.

records.mathematical_predicate: For distinct sources a,b: f_t approximately |f_a-f_b|, with positive prediction and a distinct target.
records.parameter_limits: Each unordered source pair traversed once by retained rank.
records.tolerance_rule: Target lookup is inclusive on [prediction-delta_f_R, prediction+delta_f_R]; normalized residual <=1.
records.directionality: high and low sources -> target in graph projection
records.duplicate_policy: Each matching target is retained; source peaks are excluded as targets; no additional collapse.
records.notes: Source IDs in the relationship ID follow retained-rank pair order, not frequency order.

records.parameter_limits: Every frequency-ordered left/center/right triple satisfying the predicate.
records.tolerance_rule: offset asymmetry/delta_f_R <=1; right lookup inclusive around 2 f_center-f_left.
records.directionality: center -> left and center -> right in graph projection
records.duplicate_policy: Each unique frequency-ordered triple is retained; no extra collapse.
records.notes: modulation_frequency_candidate is mean of left and right offsets; physical modulation is not confirmed.
